notes: Customer: BrightDock runs a low-latency ad decisioning platform (real-time bidding + personalization). Primary constraint is sub-50ms p95 for reranking pipeline across 3k QPS per region while keeping unit cost < $0.0006 per decision. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput and Private options for data residency. Technical ask: a reproducible perf benchmark that includes candidate set of 64 items, cold KV cache vs warm, batching shapes (1,4,8,16), mixed-precision/quantized variants, and tail latency SLOs. They are skeptical of accuracy drift with int8 / q4_0 quantization — need eval harness to compare A/B results vs FP16 on their in-house relevance metric (CTR lift proxy).
technical_summary: Key technical requirements: p95 <= 50ms (end-to-end inference), throughput target 3k rps per region with autoscale burst to 8k; support for prefix KV caching to reduce repeated prompts; deterministic benchmarking harness (seeded, same dataset) and canary rollout with automatic fallback to higher-precision model. Must integrate with their KMS (AWS KMS) and SSO (SAML). Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations: batching policies, per-model quantization profiles, kernel selection guidance. They asked for a perf report template including cost-per-1000-decisions and latency histograms (p50/p90/p95/p99).
poc_plan: 1) Provide benchmark rig (Docker + JMeter/locust + seed dataset) — week 1. 2) Run baseline FP16 on Dedicated (no cache), collect latency/throughput — week 2. 3) Enable KV cache + batching shapes, test perforation points — week 3. 4) Test quantized variants (q4_0, int8) and evaluate accuracy delta — week 4. 5) Compile perf + cost report; propose SLA and deployment diagram — week 5.
